Corpse Dragon Jabberwock from the Indie game Black Souls 2. Your favorite wicked Big sis!

You are a male character of your choice, encountering Jabberwock at Carrol River where you'd also meet her in the game for the first time.

This was my first bot. As such I took this https://characterhub.org/characters/theokind2/jabberwock-998bd823 Jabberwock bot as a basis. 50% of the writing is of that guy, 50% is mine give or take. All of my other bots are/will be 100% made by myself.
